data.name: Dilaram
data.gender_notes: Dilaram is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Persian word 'dil', meaning 'heart', and 'aram', meaning 'delight', 'sweetness', 'love'. This name is often used for girls who are believed to bring joy and love into the world. The name Dilaram carries the meaning “Delight, sweetness, love” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dilaram usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, sweetness, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the love and joy that comes from Allah and the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
data.etymology: Dilaram belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, sweetness, love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dilaram total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: ديلارام
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الحب والجمال الداخلي للإنسان
in_arabic.long_meaning: ديلارام اسم مشتق من الكلمة الفارسية، ويعبر عن الحب العميق والجمال الداخلي للإنسان، وقد ورد في بعض المصادر أنه يعني الفتاة الجميلة التي تسرح قلوب الرجال بحبها و جمالها الداخلي و الخارجي.

in_urdu.name: دیلارام
in_urdu.meaning: دیل کو موہنے والا، محبت کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: دیلارام ایک فارسی سے ماخوذ نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے دل کو موہنے والا یا محبت کرنے والا۔ یہ نام عشق و محبت کی گہرائی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے اور اکثر اس کو خوبصورت اور پیارے دل کی مالک کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: दिलाराम
in_hindi.meaning: दिल को मोह लेने वाला, प्रेम करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: दिलाराम एक नाम है जो फारसी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है दिल को मोह लेने वाला या प्रेम करने वाला। यह नाम प्रेम की गहराई और सौंदर्य को प्रकट करता है, और इसे अक्सर एक सुंदर और प्रेमपूर्ण हृदय की मालिका के रूप में समझा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: ديلارام
in_pashto.meaning: د زړه ښکلا، د مینې سورت
in_pashto.long_meaning: ديلارام د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دى، چې د زړه ښکلا او يا د مينې سورت معنی لري. دا نوم د مينې او جمال تر منځ تړاو څرګندوي او د پښتنو په کلتور کې د يوې ښکلې او مينه ناکې نجلۍ په توګه پېژندل شوی دی.

in_english.name: Dilaram
in_english.meaning: One who captures the heart with love and beauty
in_english.long_meaning: Dilaram is a name derived from Persian, meaning 'one who captures the heart' or 'beloved'. It signifies deep love and inner beauty. In Islamic tradition, this name reflects the qualities of a person who embodies love, compassion, and spiritual charm. The etymology of the name is linked to Arabic roots that emphasize love and affection.

pronunciation.hindi: दिलाराम का उच्चारण दि ला राम है
pronunciation.pashto: ديلارام د تلفظ دی لارام دی

data.spiritual_significance: The name "Dilaram" holds a deep spiritual significance, as it is derived from the words 'dil' meaning heart and 'aram' meaning delight, sweetness, or love. In the spiritual context, 'dil' or heart represents the place where the soul resides and 'aram' represents the constant longing and yearning for divine love and closeness to God. Essentially, the name "Dilaram" serves as a reminder of the spiritual journey towards loving and being loved by the Divine.

historical_references.context: Mention of Dilaram Khan, a Sultanate of Delhi ruler who converted to Islam and ruled from 1440 to 1444 CE. He was initially a Rajput prince, but embraced Islam and adopted the name Dilaram Khan.

Some variations of the name include Dilara, Dilar, and Delara. The name is gaining popularity in modern contexts, with some parents choosing it as a unique and meaningful name for their daughter.
